format: floating-point values are Java hex strings (Double.toHexString); pixel values are 24-bit RGB integers
source: testdata/Default - the Default world uses the procedural climate mask (World.json -> Mask.json); the legacy Mask.png image mask no longer exists, so the continent mask is rasterised from the real Noise.Continent configuration
seedsNote: the world seed int is used as the runtime seed and its decimal representation is used as the seed string (the loaders derive the noise seed offsets from that string)

mask.landThresholdNote: pixels are the land/ocean classification of the real continent noise at the Noise.Thresholds.Land threshold
mask.pixelsNote: rasterised mask, one entry per seed, in PixelProvider array order (index = x * height + y)

randomizerConstruction.note: the Mask.json Randomizer section is loaded by CoordinateRandomizerJsonLoader; the generator noise is ScaleNoiseProperty(SingleNoiseProperty(seedOffset, SIMPLEX), scale)

grid.note: the world coordinates sampled for every seed; the mask is sampled at the warped coordinates (rx, rz) exactly like ZonePatternGenerator.generate does
